# Dunbar Medical

> Dunbar Medical is a wholesale sports medicine supplies distributor serving North America with clinical equipment, therapeutic devices, and athletic products.

Based in Toronto and Mississauga, Canada, Dunbar Medical supplies physiotherapy clinics, sports teams, and athletic organizations with wholesale pricing on taping, bracing, compression gear, and therapeutic equipment. They serve professional accounts across Canada with comprehensive product selection tools and fast delivery.
